title: Best Neonatologist in Bangalore – Dr. Shivashankar Diggikar

settings.html:
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;12..96,500;12..96,600;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style id="neo-styles">
    /* ============================================================
       DESIGN SYSTEM — drshivdiggikar.com
       Modern Healthcare · Blue + White · 8px Grid
    ============================================================ */
    :root {
      --blue-950:  #04152d;
      --blue-900:  #0a2540;
      --blue-800:  #0d3660;
      --blue-700:  #1251a3;
      --blue-600:  #1a6ed8;
      --blue-500:  #2589ff;
      --blue-400:  #5aaeff;
      --blue-300:  #93cbff;
      --blue-100:  #deeeff;
      --blue-50:   #f0f8ff;
      --slate-900: #0f172a;
      --slate-800: #1e293b;
      --slate-700: #334155;
      --slate-600: #475569;
      --slate-500: #64748b;
      --slate-400: #94a3b8;
      --slate-200: #e2e8f0;
      --slate-100: #f1f5f9;
      --slate-50:  #f8fafc;
      --white:     #ffffff;
      --text-primary:   var(--slate-900);
      --text-secondary: var(--slate-600);
      --text-muted:     var(--slate-400);
      --border:         var(--slate-200);
      --border-blue:    #c0d9f5;
      --grad-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a2540 0%, #1251a3 55%, #2589ff 100%);
      --grad-blue:    linear-gradient(135deg, #1251a3 0%, #2589ff 100%);
      --grad-subtle:  linear-gradient(180deg, #f0f8ff 0%, #ffffff 100%);
      --shadow-xs:  0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08);
      --shadow-sm:  0 2px 8px rgba(10,37,64,0.10), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.06);
      --shadow-md:  0 4px 20px rgba(10,37,64,0.12), 0 2px 6px rgba(10,37,64,0.06);
      --shadow-lg:  0 12px 40px rgba(10,37,64,0.16), 0 4px 12px rgba(10,37,64,0.08);
      --r-sm:  8px; --r-md:  12px; --r-lg:  20px; --r-xl:  28px; --r-full: 999px;
      --sp-1:8px;--sp-2:16px;--sp-3:24px;--sp-4:32px;--sp-5:40px;--sp-6:48px;--sp-7:64px;--sp-8:80px;--sp-9:96px;--sp-10:120px;
      --transition: all 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 16px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--white);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }
    img { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    button { font-family: inherit; }

    .container { max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--sp-3); }

    h1, h2, h3 {
      font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Inter', sans-serif;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    h1 { font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 60px); font-weight: 800; }
    h2 { font-size: clamp(26px, 3.5vw, 40px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
    h3 { font-size: clamp(16px, 2vw, 20px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
    p  { line-height: 1.75; color: var(--text-secondary); }
    p:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 14px; }

    .section-tag {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blue-600); background: var(--blue-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-blue);
      padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-full); margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }
    .section-tag-white {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: var(--r-full); margin-bottom: var(--sp-2);
    }
    .section-heading { margin-bottom: var(--sp-2); }
    .section-sub { font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 600px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: var(--sp-5); }

    /* BUTTONS */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer; border: none; transition: var(--transition);
      white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .btn-primary { background: var(--grad-blue); color: var(--white); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(37,137,255,0.35); }
    .btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(37,137,255,0.45); }
    .btn-white { background: var(--white); color: var(--blue-700); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }
    .btn-white:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: var(--white);
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); }
    .btn-outline-blue {
      background: transparent; color: var(--blue-600);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--border-blue);
    }
    .btn-outline-blue:hover { background: var(--blue-50); border-color: var(--blue-600); }

    /* STICKY MOBILE CTA */
    .mobile-sticky-cta {
      display: none; position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 900;
      padding: 12px 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(10,37,64,0.12);
    }
    .mobile-sticky-cta .btn { flex: 1; padding: 13px 12px; font-size: 14px; }

    /* HERO */
    .hero { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: var(--blue-900); }
    .hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; }
    .hero-bg img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center 20%; opacity: 0.35; }
    .hero-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 20% 50%, rgba(18,81,163,0.85) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 80% 20%, rgba(37,137,255,0.3) 0%, transparent 60%),
        linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(4,21,45,0.95) 0%, rgba(10,37,64,0.75) 100%);
    }
    .hero-orb { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; }
    .hero-orb-1 { width: 400px; height: 400px; top: -100px; right: -80px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,137,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); }
    .hero-orb-2 { width: 300px; height: 300px; bottom: -60px; left: 10%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(18,81,163,0.2) 0%, transparent 70%); }
    .hero-inner { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 100%; padding: 96px 0 72px; }
    .hero-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px; gap: 64px; align-items: center; }
    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      background: rgba(37,137,255,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(90,174,255,0.35);
      border-radius: var(--r-full); padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px;
      font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--blue-300); letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .hero-badge-dot {
      width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #22c55e; border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
    }
    .hero h1 { color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 54px); }
    .hero h1 em { font-style: normal; color: var(--blue-400); }
    .hero-desc { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 36px; max-width: 520px; }
    .hero-ctas { display: flex; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 48px; }
    .hero-trust { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .hero-trust-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); font-weight: 500; }
    .hero-trust-divider { width: 1px; height: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

    .hero-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 28px; backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    .hero-card-header {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
      padding-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    .hero-avatar {
      width: 56px; height: 56px; background: var(--grad-blue); border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(37,137,255,0.4); color: white;
    }
    .hero-card-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.3; }
    .hero-card-title { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-top: 3px; }
    .cred-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .cred-item {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      border-radius: var(--r-md); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .cred-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.09); }
    .cred-item-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--blue-400); width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .cred-item-text { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; }
    .cred-item-sub { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-top: 2px; display: block; }

    /* ABOUT */
    .about-section { padding: var(--sp-10) 0; background: var(--white); }
    .about-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 440px; gap: 72px; align-items: start; margin-top: var(--sp-5); }
    .about-text p { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.85; color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .about-text p strong { color: var(--slate-800); }
    .about-text p:not(:last-child) { margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .about-highlights { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; margin-top: var(--sp-5); }
    .highlight-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
      padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--blue-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-blue); border-radius: var(--r-md);
      font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--blue-800); transition: var(--transition);
    }
    .highlight-item:hover { background: var(--blue-100); transform: translateX(4px); }
    .highlight-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--blue-600); width: 20px; height: 20px; }
    .about-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; position: sticky; top: 32px; }
    .profile-card {
      background: var(--grad-primary); border-radius: var(--r-xl);
      padding: 28px; color: var(--white); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .profile-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: -40px; right: -40px;
      width: 180px; height: 180px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .profile-card::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -30px; left: -20px;
      width: 140px; height: 140px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .profile-name { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 4px; position: relative; }
    .profile-title { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); margin-bottom: 20px; position: relative; }
    .profile-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; position: relative; }
    .profile-stat { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: var(--r-md); padding: 14px 12px; text-align: center; }
    .profile-stat-num { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--white); line-height: 1; }
    .profile-stat-label { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); margin-top: 3px; }

    /* WHY SECTION */
    .why-section { padding: var(--sp-10) 0; background: var(--grad-primary); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .why-section::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: -120px; right: -80px;
      width: 500px; height: 500px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(37,137,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .why-section::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -100px; left: -60px;
      width: 400px; height: 400px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(18,81,163,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); pointer-events: none;
    }
    .why-section h2 { color: var(--white); }
    .why-section .section-sub { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }
    .why-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-top: var(--sp-5); position: relative; }
    .why-card {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 28px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      transition: var(--transition); position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .why-card::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(90,174,255,0.5), transparent);
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }
    .why-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
    .why-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
    .why-icon {
      width: 48px; height: 48px; background: rgba(37,137,255,0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(90,174,255,0.25); border-radius: var(--r-md);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--blue-300);
    }
    .why-card h3 { color: var(--white); font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
    .why-card p { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.68); line-height: 1.7; margin: 0; }

    /* CONDITIONS / ACCORDION */
    .conditions-section { padding: var(--sp-10) 0; background: var(--slate-50); }
    .conditions-layout { margin-top: var(--sp-5); }
    .accordion { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
    .accordion-item {
      background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: var(--r-md); overflow: hidden; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }
    .accordion-item:hover { border-color: var(--border-blue); }
    .accordion-item.is-open { border-color: var(--blue-600); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37,137,255,0.08); }
    .accordion-header {
      width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 18px 22px; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slate-800); font-family: inherit;
      transition: var(--transition); gap: 12px; text-align: left;
    }
    .accordion-header:hover { background: var(--blue-50); }
    .acc-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .acc-icon {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; background: var(--blue-50); border-radius: var(--r-sm);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0; transition: background 0.2s; color: var(--blue-600);
    }
    .accordion-item.is-open .acc-icon { background: var(--blue-100); }
    .acc-arrow {
      width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--slate-100);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      flex-shrink: 0; transition: var(--transition); color: var(--slate-500);
      font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1;
    }
    .accordion-item.is-open .acc-arrow { background: var(--blue-600); color: var(--white); transform: rotate(45deg); }
    .accordion-body { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); }
    .accordion-body.open { max-height: 600px; }
    .accordion-body ul { list-style: none; padding: 8px 22px 22px 70px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
    .accordion-body ul li { position: relative; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--text-secondary); padding-left: 18px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .accordion-body ul li::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 9px; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--blue-400); border-radius: 50%; }
    .internal-links-block {
      margin-top: 24px; padding: 18px 22px; background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--r-md); border: 1px solid var(--border-blue); border-left: 4px solid var(--blue-600);
    }
    .internal-links-block p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0; }
    .internal-links-block a { color: var(--blue-600); font-weight: 600; }

    /* LOCATION */
    .location-section { padding: var(--sp-10) 0; background: var(--white); }
    .location-layout { margin-top: var(--sp-5); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 340px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .location-main-card { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-xl); overflow: hidden; box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }
    .location-card-header { padding: 28px 28px 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blue-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .location-badge {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
      background: var(--blue-600); color: var(--white);
      padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: var(--r-full); margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .location-title { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }
    .location-card-body { padding: 24px 28px; }
    .location-details { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .loc-detail-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 5px; }
    .loc-detail-value { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--slate-700); line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; }
    .areas-list {
      padding: 14px 18px; background: var(--slate-50); border-radius: var(--r-md);
      font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .location-cta-btn {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px;
      background: var(--grad-blue); color: var(--white); border-radius: var(--r-full);
      font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; transition: var(--transition); box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(37,137,255,0.35);
    }
    .location-cta-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(37,137,255,0.45); }
    .contact-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; }
    .contact-card { background: var(--grad-primary); border-radius: var(--r-xl); padding: 24px; color: var(--white); position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .contact-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -30px; right: -30px; width: 150px; height: 150px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
    .contact-card h3 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 16px; position: relative; }
    .contact-link-row {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: var(--r-md);
      font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 600; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
      margin-bottom: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s; position: relative;
    }
    .contact-link-row:last-of-type { margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .contact-link-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }
    .same-day-note { font-size: 12.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); position: relative; font-style: italic; margin: 0; }
    .hours-card { background: var(--slate-50); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--r-lg); padding: 20px; }
    .hours-card h4 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .hours-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--slate-700); }
    .hours-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .hours-row strong { color: var(--slate-900); font-weight: 600; }
    .hours-open { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #16a34a; background: #dcfce7; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--r-full); }

    /* FAQ */
    .faq-section { padding: var(--sp-10) 0; background: var(--white); }
    .faq-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 300px 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: start; margin-top: var(--sp-5); }

Conditions Treated

What Dr. Diggikar Treats

Dr. Diggikar manages the full range of newborn conditions — from common issues like jaundice to complex neonatal emergencies.

  • Neonatal Jaundice (Hyperbilirubinemia) and Phototherapy management
  • Newborn feeding difficulties and lactation support
  • Low birth weight and small-for-gestational-age infants
  • Neonatal hypoglycemia (low blood sugar in newborns)
  • Newborn infections and fever in the first month of life
  • Premature birth management (babies born before 37 weeks)
  • Neonatal Sepsis and Meningitis
  • Birth Asphyxia and Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy (HIE)
  • Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)
  • Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS)
  • Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn (TTN)
  • Neonatal Seizures
  • Intraventricular Hemorrhage (IVH)
  • Necrotizing Enterocolitis (NEC)
  • Patent Ductus Arteriosus (PDA)
  • Retinopathy of Prematurity (ROP) screening and management
  • Congenital Infections including TORCH screening
  • Congenital Hypothyroidism
  • Inborn Errors of Metabolism (IEM) — newborn metabolic screening
  • Babies discharged from the NICU often need structured follow-up to monitor growth, development, hearing, and vision.
  • Dr. Diggikar offers dedicated high-risk newborn follow-up clinics to track progress and address developmental concerns early.
  • Structured monitoring of growth, developmental milestones, hearing, and vision post-discharge.
  • Early intervention referrals for babies showing signs of developmental delay.

A neonatologist is a pediatric subspecialist trained specifically in newborn medicine — particularly premature, critically ill, or medically complex newborns. A pediatrician provides general healthcare to children from birth through adolescence. Neonatologists typically practice in NICU settings and manage the first 28 days of life and beyond for premature infants.

You should consult a neonatologist if your baby is born prematurely, has difficulty breathing at birth, shows signs of infection or severe jaundice, requires NICU admission, was diagnosed with a congenital condition before or after birth, or if your pregnancy is considered high-risk and you want antenatal counseling.
